text: The listener reads rwb.integration.FileFailed.v1 and rwb.integration.FileDelivered.v1 with the CloudEvents 1.0 envelope and the payload elements fileId, interfaceId, businessDate and caseIds, takes the attempt count, the last error code, the item status and the owner role from the rwb-integration admin read of the item, and runs as the rwb-case login of DP-02.
why: RWB-P2-E1007-CON is not readable for this work package and the legacy story names no event payload and no login; the item's own status is the only source that can separate a retry from the exception outcome without inventing a flag.
read: RWB-E1-007 sections 4, 9 and 12; P3 context pack service row and DP-02; Template and Rules R5.5 DP-09 and DP-16
confirm: Contract review of RWB-P2-E1007-CON and the platform DB story that fixes the login names
impact: Renames and one read only; no value, rule, criterion or test changes

text: The route state a case held before a failed outbound file is kept on the from-route-state element of the latest decision-record entry of that case and interface, and a delivered file restores it from there; no column and no table is added for it.
why: The legacy state table names RESUME_STATE as the target of a later successful attempt but no source names where the state to resume is held, and this secondary slice adds no schema change.
read: RWB-E1-007 section 9; P3 context pack tables (15, no resume column); Template and Rules R5.5 DP-03
confirm: Case state design review with the rwb-case owner and the decision-record library owner
impact: No schema change; the entry carries one more element and the restore reads it

text: The route-state codes for the retry and the exception route state, the task code of the outbound-file failure task, its due date rule and the task description text are reference and parameter rows of rwb-case read at the version in force, and the task is raised with the owner role the item answers.
why: The legacy story fixes that retry counts, intervals, folders, patterns and owners are data rows and never code, and names no task code value, no due date and no description text.
read: RWB-E1-007 section 8 BR8, section 11 task fields and section 14; P3 context pack parameter_value and reference_row; Template and Rules R5.5 DP-06 and DP-07
confirm: Parameter and reference-data load of rwb-case at wave 1
impact: No value is fixed in code; a missing row fails the listener with no task and no state change

text: The case side of an outbound file outcome is an internal service of the file-outcome listener: it adds no REST operation, and the exception-queue read, the resend and the item stay with rwb-integration behind its admin operation.
why: The legacy published interfaces CaseEvents.raise and TaskApi.raiseTask are in-process calls with no target operation, and the P3 operation list contains no case-action and no task-raise path.
read: RWB-E1-007 sections 10 and 12 and section 13 build step 5; P3 context pack REST operation list; Template and Rules R5.5 DP-11 and DP-16
confirm: Architecture review of the case contract
impact: No path is added; a caller that expected a case-action operation calls nothing and the outcome arrives as an event
